display_name: Cosmic XR - Space In Your Room
display_long_description:
**Welcome to Cosmic XR — your immersive gateway to space, the universe, and beyond, right in your room.**  With **passthrough Mixed Reality**, your environment transforms into a living map of the cosmos. Embark on an interactive space exploration journey filled with galaxies, planets, moons, and black holes.  

[media] 

 **Reach out with your hands to touch, rotate, and scale** beautifully detailed planets. Cradle Earth, spin Saturn’s rings, or watch storms swirl on Jupiter. Every celestial object responds with lifelike motion and scale. Explore moons like Ganymede, Callisto, and Titan. 

[media]  

Travel from the vast cosmic web to scattered galaxies, into the Milky Way and our Solar System, down to the Galactic Center and its mysterious black hole, Sagittarius A*.  

[media] 

Drift through dark matter filaments, hover above spiral arms, and gaze at Andromeda. Dive into warped light where space and time bend around you. 

[media]  

Whether you're a stargazer or simply curious about the cosmos, Cosmic XR brings the universe into your room.  **The universe is no longer out there. It’s right here — in your hands.**
